friendly_name: Doctor flags org-pack nodes whose body_path escapes the pack
purpose_context: A team that shares governance through an org pack relies on doctor charter-packs to say whether the pack is sound. Today a fragment node whose body_path leaves the pack folder (a ../ path or an absolute path) is reported healthy with exit 0, and nothing names the path (#6418, GA-gating P1). This mission makes the doctor run the existing containment check on those nodes and report each escape, so the pack reads unhealthy and the command exits non-zero.
purpose_tldr: doctor charter-packs stops reporting a team pack healthy when a node in its graph fragment points outside the pack folder.
